description: This Java source file defines the MessageProcessor class, which is responsible for processing and analyzing message-related data within an IPC (Inter-Process Communication) framework. It includes methods for building message models from XML configuration, analyzing message parameters for dependencies, and managing message lookups.

classes.name: MessageProcessor
classes.description: A helper class that creates and analyzes message objects for IPC communication, providing methods for model building, dependency analysis, and message lookup management.

methods.name: buildModel
methods.description: Constructs a MessageProcessor instance from an ICService object, creating Message and MessageWrapper objects for each message defined in the service's IPC configuration.

methods.name: analyze
methods.description: Analyzes message parameters within the service configuration to identify dependencies on various data types and structures, aiding in code generation or validation.

methods.name: getWrappers
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the MessageWrapper objects contained within this processor, used during code generation or further analysis.
